scope: Long-Term Unified Gambit SMP Architecture (Wave A -> Slice 1 FrameSpec -> Slice 2 Concurrent Major GC -> Slice 3 kqueue/epoll & SRFI-230/Parallel Stdlib -> Slice 4 Gerbil SMP & 12/12 Seal)

papers.title: A Parallel Virtual Machine for Efficient Scheme Compilation
papers.adopted: Logical frames, bidirectional target knowledge, explicit operand storage classes, measurement feedback loop.
papers.non_import: PVM futures do not prove SMP safety or allow simultaneous multi-core invocation of a single continuation.

papers.title: Polling Efficiently on Stock Hardware
papers.adopted: Inexpensive allocation/stack limit polling and fast-span grant reload at explicit safepoints.
papers.non_import: Polling alone does not cover blocking C FFI without Tier 3.3 park/unpark participation.

papers.title: A Portable Implementation of First-Class Continuations for Unrestricted Interoperability with C in a Multithreaded Scheme
papers.adopted: Lazy stack-to-heap frame capture, break frames, multi-shot continuation semantics with C interoperability.
papers.non_import: Captured mature heap frames remain mutable (##frame-set!); old age never implies immutability.

papers.title: Compiler Support for Garbage Collection in a Statically Typed Language
papers.authors: Amer Diwan, J. Eliot B. Moss, Richard L. Hudson
papers.adopted: Compiler-generated exact per-call-site pointer liveness maps decoupled from runtime scanning logic.
papers.non_import: Static-type assumptions are replaced by Gambit dynamic tags plus explicit unboxed raw-slot scrubbing.

papers.title: Real-Time Garbage Collection on General-Purpose Machines
papers.venue: Journal of Systems and Software, Vol. 11(3), pp. 181-198, 1990
papers.adopted: Snapshot-At-The-Beginning (SATB) pre-store deletion barrier + black-allocation during mark phase for bounded termination.
papers.non_import: Single-processor assumptions are replaced by C11/C23 release-acquire synchronization and per-processor SATB buffers.

papers.title: Very Concurrent Mark-&-Sweep Garbage Collection without Fine-Grain Synchronization
papers.adopted: Epoch/color-bit non-moving mark-and-sweep allowing concurrent mutators, markers, and sweepers with coarse-grain phase barriers.
papers.non_import: C11 data-race freedom requires explicit atomic mark-word operations rather than unguarded racy loads/stores.

papers.title: Immix: A Mark-Region Garbage Collector with Space Efficiency, Fast Collection, and Mutator Performance
papers.authors: Stephen M. Blackburn, Kathryn S. McKinley
papers.adopted: Block/line mark-region non-moving mature allocation with opportunistic defragmentation, fitting Gambit msection blocks without 2x semispace RSS overhead.
papers.non_import: Opportunistic evacuation only runs at STW defragmentation cuts; ordinary concurrent major cycles remain strictly non-moving.

papers.title: Parallel Generational-Copying Garbage Collection with a Block-Structured Heap
papers.authors: Simon Marlow, Tim Harris, Roshan P. James, Simon Peyton Jones
papers.adopted: Block-structured parallel generational evacuation, card/remembered-set scanning, work-stealing parallel promotion.
papers.non_import: GHC lazy-thunk promotion heuristics and thunk blackholing do not transfer to strict Scheme.

papers.title: Retrofitting Parallelism onto OCaml
papers.authors: KC Sivaramakrishnan, Stephen Dolan, Leo White, Sadiq Jaffer, Tom Kelly, Anmol Sahoo, Sudha Parimala, Atul Dhiman, Anil Madhavapeddy
papers.adopted: Coordinated STW parallel Minor GC paired with non-moving concurrent SATB Major GC (piggybacking major phase transitions on minor barriers) and C-FFI domain rendezvous.
papers.non_import: OCaml single-shot effect-handler stacks and OCaml's C volatile/fence idioms are not imported; Gambit keeps multi-shot continuations and C11/C23 atomics.

papers.title: A Fully Concurrent Garbage Collector for Functional Programs on Multicore Processors
papers.adopted: Non-moving bitmap-marked segments + SATB write-barrier buffers + lock-free segment handoff for functional runtimes.
papers.non_import: SML# tagless bitmap layouts differ from Gambit tagged words and still-object refcount headers.

papers.title: Kqueue: A Generic and Scalable Event Notification Facility
papers.adopted: Persistent kernel interest registration (kevent on macOS/BSD, paired with epoll on Linux), O(ready) delivery, EVFILT_USER/eventfd wakeup, eliminating FD_SETSIZE=1024 and O(N) select/poll.
papers.non_import: Kernel FD reuse still requires explicit userspace generation/custody fencing before close(fd).

papers.title: Correct and Efficient Work-Stealing for Weak Memory Models
papers.authors: Nhat Minh Le, Antoniu Pop, Albert Cohen, Francesco Zappa Nardelli
papers.adopted: C11 relaxed/acquire/release/seq_cst Chase-Lev work-stealing deque proven sound on ARM64 and POWER weak memory models.
papers.non_import: Does not automatically prove GC root visibility of deque slots; deque elements must reside in GC-traced Scheme vectors or registered roots.

papers.title: SRFI 230: Atomic Operations
papers.adopted: Standard Scheme atomic-box, atomic-fxbox, atomic-flag, atomic-pair, and explicit memory-order fences lowered directly onto Gambit's native C23 ___ORDERED_WORD_NATIVE primitives.
papers.non_import: Ordinary Scheme vector-set!/set-car! remain DRF-0 non-atomic writes.
